finalText:
CHANGELOG.md now has the 4.2.0 entry, in the same three-heading shape as before.

A few things worth flagging as you review before cutting the release:

- **The 401/403 change is a real behavioral break** — I put it under Breaking since existing client error-handling that checks for 403 on expired tokens will now see 401. Worth double-checking with whoever owns auth that this was intentional and not an accidental status-code regression.
- **The "empty allowlist" fix (store/db/jobs)** — the commit log only gives me the diffstat, not the actual diff, so I couldn't confirm which direction the bug went (was it wrongly allowing everything, or wrongly rejecting everything?). I wrote it generically as "unexpected behavior" — you may want to tighten that wording if you know the actual impact.
- I dropped all the perf commits (batched metric writes, avoided clones, skipped JSON round-trips, reused parsed schemas) since they don't change observable behavior — happy to add a Performance section if you want them called out.
- I noticed several of these "fixes" (null-cursor paginator, duplicate headers, empty allowlist, trailing slash, trace-id) were fixed **independently in 3-4 different modules** over the six weeks — same bug class, separate implementations. I merged those into single bullets rather than listing each module's fix as its own line item.
